title: Speaking Practice 22 - Environmental Responsibility
description: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Discussion questions about environmental responsibility.

stimuli.title: Part 3: Environmental Responsibility Discussion
stimuli.content: In Part 3, the examiner asks abstract questions. Give extended answers with examples.

questionGroups.instruction: Discuss the following questions. Give detailed answers with examples.

questions.content: Whose responsibility is it to protect the environment?

explanation.sampleAnswer: It is a shared responsibility. Governments need to create and enforce regulations, businesses must adopt sustainable practices, and individuals should make eco-friendly choices in daily life.

questions.content: Can individual actions really make a difference?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, when millions of people make small changes like reducing plastic use or choosing public transport, the collective impact is significant.

questions.content: Should companies be punished for pollution?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Absolutely. Heavy fines and public accountability create financial incentives for companies to invest in clean technology and sustainable practices.

questions.content: What environmental problems are most urgent right now?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Climate change and ocean plastic pollution are the most pressing. Both have far-reaching consequences that affect ecosystems, weather patterns, and human health globally.
